summary: paid-organic-gap gains --days (default 7) to bound the paid-keyword window, chunks rank lookups into groups of 5, and requests aggregated bids.
reason: apps/keywords/bids bills 1,000 credits for the first day plus 100 per extra day; the default 30-day window cost about 3,900 credits per call.
validated_outcome: paid-organic-gap --days 1 returned 61 paid keywords and ranked the top 50, at 1,522 credits.
